title: Spicy Brazilian Mackerel Cakes
description: A flavorful dish from Brazil, these mackerel cakes are packed with spices and served with a crunchy croute topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flaked mackerel, croute, spicy sauce, Brazilian spice blend, kicked chili powder, salt, and black pepper.
Stir in the crème fraîche and lime juice until well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 4-6 patties.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the patties to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the mackerel cakes hot with your favorite sides.
